core_conclusion: Compare independently trained Stage3B and Stage7A candidate geometry on frozen official VAL, with paired scene uncertainty and a same-checkpoint semantic-input ablation.
archetype: quantitative grid plus matched prediction cases
main_evidence: Overall primary minFDE and vehicle/pedestrian/moving comparisons; paired CI on Stage7A minus Stage3B.
difficulty_evidence: Prespecified vehicle displacement, intersection, nearby turn and offline GT-turning subgroups; secondary exploratory unadjusted intervals.
ablation_evidence: Semantic ON and ZERO input with one identical trained checkpoint; does not equal a retrained geometry baseline and retains learned MLP bias.
case_selection: TurningVehicle_GT largest minFDE reduction; NearTrafficControl20 moving vehicle with GT displacement>5m largest reduction excluding first identity; largest degradation among vehicles with GT displacement>5m excluding earlier identities. If no eligible improvement, label honestly; cases are deliberately selected illustrations, not prevalence evidence.
case_integrity: Exact same actor/history/GT/map/axes; all six candidates shown; best-FDE path solid and Top1 path dashed; actual raw predicted arrays saved to source JSON.
dimensions: 183mm width; quantitative about85mm high; cases about105mm high
statistics: 150 scene clusters,1000 paired percentile bootstrap replicates,seed2022; one training seed per method, no inference to seed variability
review_risks: GT-defined turn group is offline only
selected examples are not aggregate evidence
static semantic controls do not encode signal state
learned residual norms are not causal effects
